name: CaseComboboxListboxStackingOrder
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "combobox-listbox-stacking-order" (combobox). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: `z-index: 10` on an absolutely positioned listbox that OVERLAPS its trigger - explicit paint order, not document order
